Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings for this match. The action now moves to Rajkot for the decider. It's on Saturday, the 7th of January, at 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT). Do join us early for the build-up. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Dasun Shanaka, the captain of Sri Lanka, is also the Player of the Match! Starts by admitting that they could have done better in the middle phase as the game was well set by the openers. On dew being a factor for India's comeback, Dasun replies that it's not the dew factor and it was the skill of the Indian batters. Praises Axar Patel and Suryakumar Yadav for taking the game away for a brief period. Tells that it's good to defend a total like this, especially against a team like India.

Hardik Pandya, the Indian skipper, starts by admitting that they were poor in both the Powerplays. Says that they made basic errors that they should not at this level. Mentions that everyone knows what they have done wrong and it's a learning phase for them. Calls it a cracker of a game and praises the knocks of Axar Patel, Suryakumar Yadav and Shivam Mavi. Wants his team to focus on doing the basics right. Adds that no balls are something you can control and these are basic errors the bowlers should not be making. Shares that Rahul Tripathi is very accustomed to batting at number 3 and they want to give someone new to the team a role they are comfortable with.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Kasun Rajitha comes up for a quick word. Says that he loves this ground and adds that they knew that there will be swing under lights. Tells that they got worried during the partnership between Axar Patel and Suryakumar Yadav as the Lankan bowlers didn't do the basics right. He is happy that they closed the game when it mattered the most.

India will look back at this game with a lot of remorse for the way they bowled but a lot of appreciation for the way they put up a fight with the bat. Bowling seven no balls is unacceptable and that in a way allowed Sri Lanka the rhythm to finish strongly. The chase was very much neck and neck and India were a shade ahead at the start of the final five overs but the pressure of the asking rate got the better of them. Still, full marks to them for making this a thrilling contest.

The Sri Lankan bowling was very skilful and disciplined in the Powerplay. They broke the back of the Indian batting very early. Dilshan Madushanka and Kasun Rajitha were exceptional with the new ball and the latter finished with figures of 4-0-22-2 in this high-scoring humdinger. Really commendable. The other bowlers went for aplenty and that was the reason why Dasun Shanaka decided to bowl the last over himself. He did it with the bat earlier, helping his team to gather 20 runs off the final over and then he stepped up to defend those runs. Captain leading from the front!

After losing four wickets inside the Powerplay, you don't win many games. India were further reduced to 57 for 5 and it appeared to be an early finish. But as mentioned earlier, after the halfway mark, they stepped on the gas. Not to forget, the carnage started after the run-out chance of Axar Patel was missed on 8. Patel unleashed after that event and his onslaught shell-shocked the Lankan team. Suryakumar Yadav was not at his usual best but had he lasted for another over or two, India could have nailed the chase. Towards the end, Shivam Mavi also showed his ball-hitting prowess but that was not enough.

What an entertainer! Sri Lanka were roaring at one stage and it looked like a straightforward win for them but the pair of Suryakumar Yadav and Axar Patel reignited hopes in the Indian camp and took it deep. Their association (91 off 40 balls) scared the Lankan Lions but eventually, the touring team secured the win and levelled the series 1-1.

OUT! TAKEN! Dasun Shanaka gets another wicket! He bowls another full toss, on off, Shivam Mavi miscues his shot in the air and Maheesh Theekshana at extra cover backtracks to take the catch. SRI LANKA WIN BY 16 RUNS!
Commentary.Howout: c Maheesh Theekshana b Dasun Shanaka

Commentary.Commentary: Overpitched, on off, Shivam Mavi lofts it towards long off, but denies the single.
Full and on middle, Umran Malik lofts it over the bowler's head for a single.
Who will come in next? It's Umran Malik.

OUT! TAKEN! Dasun Shanaka has done it for Sri Lanka! Axar Patel misses out there. This is a high full toss, outside off, Axar Patel smashes it towards the long off fence where Chamika Karunaratne runs to his right and takes a splendid catch. The on-field umpire gets it checked for the high-waist full toss but it's fine and the catch is also clean. With that, India's hopes of getting a win diminish.
Commentary.Howout: c Chamika Karunaratne b Dasun Shanaka

Commentary.Commentary: Full again and on off, Axar Patel drives it wide of deep cover and comes back for the second run.
Fuller one and on off, Shivam Mavi forces it towards long off for just a run. 20 runs needed in 5 balls now with Axar Patel on strike.
Dasun Shanaka has decided to bowl the last over himself. India need 21.
FOUR! Yes, he can! This is a full toss, on off, Axar Patel smashes it wide of long off for four runs. What a chase this has turned out to be, going down to the wire!
Kasun Rajitha nails the yorker again, on middle, Shivam Mavi jams it towards long on for one. Can Axar Patel hit a boundary on the last ball?
A dot! Sri Lankan players gets some relief. Kasun Rajitha serves another low full toss, outside off, Shivam Mavi slashes hard at it, but misses.
Another low full toss, Shivam Mavi slogs it wide of long on and comes back for the second.
A low full toss, on off, Axar Patel drills it towards long on for just a run. 28 runs needed in 10 balls now.
Kasun Rajitha goes for the wide yorker, outside off, Axar Patel digs it out towards sweeper cover for a brace.
Another wide! This is way, way outside off, Axar Patel lets it go to the keeper. Kasun Rajitha is under pressure here.
Kasun Rajitha bowls this full and outside off, way outside off, Axar Patel tries to reach for it but misses. It is called a wide.
The replay showed that Harshal Patel tried to run in with the message before the start of this over but Axar had sent him back.

SIX! BANG! Make that 16 off 3! Shivam Mavi is playing a blinder here. Dilshan Madushanka bowls the slower one, full and on off, Shivam Mavi picks it up, waits for it and smokes it over the bowler's head for a maximum. India need 33 runs in the last two overs!
FOUR! 10 runs off 2 balls! This is full and outside off, Shivam Mavi backs away and chips it over extra cover for a boundary.

SIX! Shivam Mavi comes up with a huge hit! Dilshan Madushanka tries to surprise the batter and bangs in a short delivery on middle, Shivam Mavi stays there and pulls it mightily over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Swing and a miss! Dilshan Madushanka serves this full and outside off, angling away, Shivam Mavi makes room, but fails to reach it and misses.
Fuller and on off, Axar Patel drills it through covers for a single.
Dilshan Madushanka continues to bowl pin-point yorkers, on leg this time, Axar Patel only manages to dig onto his boot as the ball goes towards the bowler.
Washington Sundar comes out in the middle between the overs to pass on the message from Hardik Pandya.​ Dilshan Madushanka to continue...

FOUR! Shivam Mavi gets a much-needed boundary. Maheesh Theekshana bowls this short again and outside off, Shivam Mavi stays there and slaps it through extra cover for a boundary. India need 50 runs in 18 balls now!
Floated, full and on middle, Axar Patel lofts it on the bounce towards long on for a single.
Short again and outside off, Axar Patel miscues his pull shot in the air, but it lands safely in front of long off. Two runs taken!
Shortish and on off, Shivam Mavi pushes it through covers and gives the strike back to Axar Patel.
Flatter, full and on off, Shivam Mavi swings across the line, but only connects with thin air.

Stumping appeal! It's referred upstairs. Maheesh delivers a full toss around middle and leg, Mavi gets across to scoop but it takes the inner half and drops onto the left pad of the keeper. It then deflects onto the stumps. The keeper picks up the ball and removes the leg stump before appealing. It's referred upstairs. The third umpire first confirms that the ball has bounced off the keeper's pad and then hit the stumps to rule out any caught behind. After that, the side-on angle confirms that Mavi's back leg was inside the crease when the ball deflected onto the stumps. Also, Mavi had ventured out but dragged his bat inside the crease when Mendis removed the leg pole. All good, Mavi can continue!
Maheesh Theekshana (3-0-25-0) to bowl out.
Dilshan Madushanka nails another yorker, on middle, angling in, Shivam Mavi manages to get an inside edge onto his pads as the ball goes towards third man. They cross.
Shivam Mavi is the new batter.

OUT! TAKEN! Dilshan Madushanka gets a huge, huge wicket for Sri Lanka. The crowd goes absolutely silent here at the MCA Stadium. Dilshan Madushanka serves this full and outside off, Suryakumar Yadav looks to loft it over long off, but loses his grip and skies it up in the air off the inner half of his bat. Wanindu Hasaranga at long on settles under it and takes a good catch under pressure. This could prove to be the turning point of this game. 59 needed off 25 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Wanindu Hasaranga b Dilshan Madushanka

Commentary.Commentary: Brilliant stuff! Dilshan Madushanka nails a perfect yorker, outside off, Suryakumar Yadav tries to get some bat on it, but misses.
Fuller in length, on off, Axar Patel drives it towards long off for a run.
A yorker wide outside off, Suryakumar Yadav squeezes it through backward point for a single.

SIX! FIFTY FOR SKY! He gets to it with his favourite shot as well. This is full and around leg, Suryakumar Yadav this time connects with his lap shot and sends it flying over long leg for a biggie. India are roaring in this chase!
WIDE! Dilshan Madushanka loses his line and serves this full and down the leg side, Suryakumar Yadav moves across to play the lap shot but misses. It is called a wide.
Dilshan Madushanka comes back into the attack.

Another single to complete an expensive over for Sri Lanka. Slower ball outside off, short in length, Yadav cuts but fails to find the gap between short third man and backward point. It's stopped with a dive and they get a run. 68 needed off 30 balls.
Back of a length, around off, Axar slaps it down to long off for one.

SIX! Axar Patel is in a killer mood at the moment, completing his fifty off just 20 balls. Fuller in length, around off, Axar Patel aligns himself and hoists it over long off for a maximum. 70 needed off 32 balls.
Fuller delivery around off, Yadav goes hard at it and knocks it down to long on for one.
Slower one, on a length around off, Yadav tries to shuffle across and paddle but misses. DOT!
SIX! India are batting in top gear! Fuller in length around off, right in the slot, Suryakumar Yadav latches onto it and thrashes it over long off.
Chamika Karunaratne (3-0-26-1) to bowl out now.
Quicker and on off, it's punched to the right of the point fielder for a run. 26 off the over, can India build on this momentum?

SIX! SKY joins the party! Loopy delivery, landing full and outside off, Suryakumar Yadav advances down the track and rockets it over extra cover for a biggie. The crowd is going bonkers. 84 needed off 37 balls.
Flatter and quicker, around middle and leg, Patel eases it down to long on and rotates the strike. 19 from the over already.

SIX! A hat-trick of sixes and India are trying to make a comeback! Full and around off, Patel skips down the track and launches it over long off for a biggie. The required rate comes down to 14 now. India need to keep finding those boundaries.

SIX! Axar is changing gears and India are getting a lifeline here in the form of this partnership which is worth fifty now! Floated ball, around off, Axar Patel kneels down and clobbers it against the spin. Generates enough power and clears deep mid-wicket.
SIX! Dismissed! Full and floated, around leg, Axar Patel goes down on one knee and smokes it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Halt! Suryakumar Yadav gets a new bat now. Also, Wanindu Hasaranga comes back in the attack.
Another full toss, on middle, knocked down to long on for a single. 13 from the over, 109 needed off 42 balls.
A low full toss on middle, SKY flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Follows the batter down the leg side with a flatter delivery, Patel steps back and tickles it to mid-wicket for one.
SIX! India need many more of these! Flighted delivery, full and landing around off, Axar Patel wears his skates and clubs it over long on for a biggie.
FOUR! Short in length and outside off, Axar Patel latches onto it and whacks it over covers for a boundary.
Flighted and on off, pushed to covers.
Eases a full ball down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Edgy! Short and on off, Axar Patel top-edges his attempted pull shot behind the keeper for a boundary.

Terrible miscommunication and Axar Patel is very lucky to survive a run out chance. Length delivery outside off, Yadav shuffles across for the paddle scoop but fails to connect cleanly. It rolls to the left of the keeper and Axar Patel comes out of the crease in search of a run. SKY is not interested but his partner is almost at his end. Kusal Mendis fires in a very ordinary throw to the bowler who dives but fails to collect it cleanly on the first attempt. Patel gets the time to sprint back and survives. Chamika attempts for a flick at the stumps but misses and now the batters cross for an overthrow.
Short and outside off, Axar slaps it over extra cover for just a single.
On middle, a length ball, Yadav helps it in front of square leg for a single.
FOUR! Again SKY starts the over with a boundary. Picks a length ball outside off and lifts it cleanly over extra cover.
Chamika Karunaratne (2-0-14-1) is back on.
Flatter and quicker on off, Axar punches off the back foot to extra cover. The asking rate is close to 15 now.
Very full and on off, SKY drives it through covers for a single.
Shortish and on off, Patel goes on the back foot and hits it past mid-wicket for a single.
Maheesh drops it short and on off, Yadav bends his back knee and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and on off, it's driven to deep cover and the fielder there makes a fine diving stop. Saves two runs.
FOUR! A good way to start the over! Flighted delivery, full and around off, Suryakumar Yadav leans forward and lofts it over extra cover for a boundary.

Dropped! Wanindu Hasaranga bowls this quicker, short and outside off, angling away, Axar Patel looks to cut it, but gets a thin outside edge towards the keeper where Kusal Mendis fails to grab it. A tough chance, and it goes begging and Axar Patel gets a life.
SIX! BANG! Axar Patel gets off the mark in style! This tossed up, full and on leg, Axar Patel goes down and slog-sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Slightly shorter and on middle, Axar Patel looks to flick it away, but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
Floated, full and on middle, Axar Patel knocks it to the left of the bowler again as Wanindu Hasaranga fields it.
Short and down the leg side, Axar Patel misses to connect with his sweep shot. Wided.
Tossed up, full and on off, Axar Patel drives it to the left of the bowler where Wanindu Hasaranga dives and parries it towards short mid-wicket.

Drinks break. Sri Lanka are bossing this game! They have not put a single foot wrong with their bowling plans and have India on the mat. Suryakumar Yadav is India's last hope and he will be looking for some support from the lower order. The asking rate is close to 14 now as Axar Patel walks in next.

OUT! TAKEN! Wanindu Hasaranga strikes! Deepak Hooda has to go back for a low score this time around. Wanindu Hasaranga bowls a leg-spinner, short and outside off, Deepak Hooda goes on his back foot and tries to pull it away, but the ball sticks to the surface a bit and Hooda fails to get any timing on that and slices it instead. As a result, the ball flies in the air towards long on where Dhananjaya de Silva runs forward and takes a nice diving catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Dhananjaya de Silva b Wanindu Hasaranga

Commentary.Commentary: Wanindu Hasaranga comes back from the opposite end.
Darts this one on a yorker length and on leg, Suryakumar Yadav jams it to the leg side.

Quicker one, full and on middle, Suryakumar Yadav moves across to play the sweep, but gets a bottom edge onto the keeper's pads as the ball goes to short fine leg. There is an appeal for LBW but turned down. It was clearly off the bat.
Maheesh Theekshana continues with his shorter length, on middle this time, Deepak Hooda tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and around middle, Suryakumar Yadav stays there and punches it towards long off for a run.
Shortish and on middle, Deepak Hooda lofts it towards long on for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana starts with a quicker delivery, short and outside off, Deepak Hooda misses his cut.

Fuller one and outside off, Suryakumar Yadav goes for the drive, but gets a thick outside edge past point. They get two runs but the umpire gives it one short. The replays though show that Yadav's bat slip away after getting stuck at the crease but it gets dragged a bit inside the line and was in touch with SKY's gloves. The on-field umpire changes his decision and two runs have been added to the total.
On a length and on off, Suryakumar Yadav pushes it towards short cover. It seems like the bat is broken and Suryakumar Yadav has asked for a new one.
Overpitched and around off, Suryakumar Yadav drives it firmly, but straight to mid off.
FOUR! Suryakumar Yadav find the fence this time! This is full and outside off, Suryakumar Yadav frees his arms and slices it over backward point for a boundary.
Fuller one and on off, Suryakumar Yadav mistimes his drive back towards the bowler.
This is on a good length and around leg, Deepak Hooda flicks it off the back foot through square leg for a single.
Chamika Karunaratne gets a change of ends.
Flatter, full and on off, Deepak Hooda drives it towards long on for one more.
Quciker one, full and on middle, Suryakumar Yadav drills it towards long off for one.
Flighted, full and on middle, Deepak Hooda tucks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
A bit short and on middle, Deepak Hooda pulls it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Floated, full and on off, Suryakumar Yadav drags his sweep shot towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga starts with a tossed-up delivery, full and on middle, Suryakumar Yadav goes inside-out and drives it wide of sweeper cover for a brace.
Wanindu Hasaranga comes into the attack.
Kasun Rajitha bowls this on a good length and on off, Suryakumar Yadav looks to push it away, but gets an outside edge towards third man for a run. A brilliant Powerplay for Sri Lanka!
On a length and on off, Suryakumar Yadav knocks it towards short cover.
Misfield! This is on a hard length and on off, Suryakumar Yadav punches it towards mid off where Dasun Shanaka lets it through his legs and allows the second run.
Goes a bit fuller and on middle, Suryakumar Yadav gets squared up a bit and the ball goes off the outer edge towards point.
Short of a length and outside off, Deepak Hooda cuts it through point for a single.
This is on a good length and on off, Deepak Hooda dabs it towards backward point.
This one nips back in around off, Hooda helps it gently in front of square leg for a run. 172 needed off 90 balls.
Angling in from a length around off, Hooda defends it from the back foot to the off side.
Deepak Hooda is in at number 6.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! What a stupendous flying catch by Kusal Mendis! India are in tatters - four top-order batters back in the hut. Chamika Karunaratne sends across an outswinger, on a length and close to off, Hardik Pandya tries to get close to the delivery as he attempts to drive but it takes the outside edge and scoots behind. Kusal Mendis reacts well and takes a stunning catch diving across to his right.
Commentary.Howout: c Kusal Mendis b Chamika Karunaratne

Commentary.Commentary: A gem of a delivery! What a beauty! Chamika Karunaratne delivers it on a length around off, Pandya is squared up in defense as it whistles past the outside edge.
Blind swing and a miss! Short in length and outside off, Hardik rocks back and tries to pull but fails to connect. Chamika Karunaratne stares and smiles.
SIX! Hammered away! Fuller in length, around off, Hardik Pandya keeps his weight on the back foot and sends it packing over long on. A flat maximum.
Chamika Karunaratne comes into the attack now.
A length ball on middle, angling in at 136.4 kph, Suryakumar Yadav tries to flick but closes the face of his bat early. It goes off the leading edge to point. Another excellent over from Sri Lanka.
A touch short in length, on off, Pandya forces it from the back foot to wide mid off and takes a single.
On a length around off, angling in with some extra bounce, Pandya is taken by surprise as he fends it away on the off side.
Back of a length on off, shaping away, Hardik punches on the up and it goes on one bounce to the point fielder.
Beauty! Excellent line and length. Around off and it's an outswinger, Pandya stays back-footed as he tries to punch through the line. Gets beaten.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Hardik goes on the back foot and defends it down on the surface.
Play and a miss! Dilshan Madushanka delivers an outswinger outside off, Yadav tries to reach out and drive but gets beaten. Superb over from Dilshan!
Pitches it up and around off, Suryakumar Yadav plays close to his body and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Shortish and on middle, Hardik plays a mistimed pull shot to square leg for a single.
Inswinger, on a full length outside off, again Pandya drags his attempted drive to mid on.

FOUR! Not from the middle of the bat though. A length delivery on middle, nipping in, Hardik Pandya tries to whip it over mid-wicket but instead drags it off the inner edge to deep backward square leg. Gets a boundary as the bowler has his hands on his head.
Wide! A length ball around leg, the swing takes it down the leg side, Hardik tries to flick but misses.
The skipper, Hardik Pandya walks out to bat now with India in a spot of bother.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! India are reeling now. Dilshan Madushanka delivers it full and around off, getting it to go on with the angle, Rahul Tripathi tries to drive it down the ground but gets a thick outside edge. Kusal Mendis does the rest and India have lost three wickets inside the first three overs.
Commentary.Howout: c Kusal Mendis b Dilshan Madushanka

Commentary.Commentary: Suryakumar Yadav comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kasun Rajitha has his second and he has sent both the Indian openers packing. A touch short and around off at 130.5 kph, not short enough to pull though. Shubman Gill stays back to attempt his favourite wristy pull shot but goes half-hearted at it. The ball takes the top edge and flies to mid on where it's a simple catch for Maheesh Theekshana. India on the back foot!
Commentary.Howout: c Maheesh Theekshana b Kasun Rajitha

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and outside off, Rahul steers it through backward point for a single.
Halt! The last ball went off the helmet of Rahul Tripathi. So, a mandatory concussion check is going on. Everything seems fine now and we are ready to continue.

FOUR LEG BYES! Rahul Tripathi is an inventive batter and he is not showing any nerves. Attempts for the paddle scoop as he shuffles across and it takes his bat before brushing the helmet and flying to fine leg for a boundary. The umpire though has given it leg byes. No bat, no gloves, confirms the replays.
FOUR! Shot! What a way to open your account in international cricket! Slightly short in length, around off, Rahul Tripathi steps down the track and clobbers it through cover-point for a boundary.
Lands it on a length outside off, shaping away, Rahul Tripathi covers the line and shoulders arms.
The debutant, Rahul Tripathi walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Sharp delivery from Kasun Rajitha. He delivers it full and around off, nipping back in a bit with superb pace, Ishan Kishan stands back to whip it over the leg side but ends up playing all over it. The ball sneaks behind to rattle the stumps and it's a big setback for India. 195 runs needed in 113 balls!
Who will bowl from the other end? It will be Kasun Rajitha.
FOUR! Top shot from Gill! Very full in length, around leg and shaping in, Shubman Gill picks it off his pads and flicks it beautifully through mid-wicket.

FIVE WIDES! Wrong line from the bowler. A touch short in length, around leg and shaping down, Gill tries to flick but misses. It takes off and beats the keeper as well before racing away to the fence at fine leg.
Back of a length, close to off, Kishan steps back and steers it past backward point for a run.
Beaten again! This is a serious first over. In the channel around off, on a length and nipping away, Kishan again tries to drive but is beaten on the outside edge this time.
Beaten! Lovely delivery. This one is on a length around off, Kishan presses forward to drive with the movement but it holds its line and beats the inside edge.
Edgy! Dilshan Madushanka pitches it up and around off, and Shubman Gill draws forward to play with a straight bat but it takes the outside edge and runs down to third man for a run.
Starts with a shortish delivery, around off and shaping away, Ishan pushes inside the line and guides it down to third man for a run.
